name: OpenHuman conflicted-PR triage and fix

args.script:
set -euo pipefail
REPO=tinyhumansai/openhuman
OUT="$HOME/todo.txt"
PRS=$(mktemp)
gh pr list -R "$REPO" --json number,title,author,updatedAt,isDraft,mergeable --limit 200 > "$PRS"
{
  echo "# Conflicted open PRs on $REPO"
  jq -r '.[] | [.number, .mergeable, .isDraft, (.author.login // "?"), (.updatedAt|split("T")[0]), .title] | @tsv' "$PRS" |
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r n m draft author updated title; do
    # GitHub computes mergeability lazily; re-ask until it settles.
    if [ "$m" = "UNKNOWN" ]; then
      for _ in 1 2 3; do
        sleep 2
        m=$(gh pr view "$n" -R "$REPO" --json mergeable --jq .mergeable)
        [ "$m" = "UNKNOWN" ] || break
      done
    fi
    [ "$m" = "CONFLICTING" ] || continue
    if [ "$draft" = "true" ]; then d=" [draft]"; else d=""; fi
    printf -- "- #%s%s (%s, updated %s) %s\n  https://github.com/%s/pull/%s\n" "$n" "$d" "$author" "$updated" "$title" "$REPO" "$n"
  done
} > "$OUT"
rm -f "$PRS"
echo "wrote $(grep -c '^- #' "$OUT") conflicted PRs to $OUT"

description: Survey open PRs on tinyhumansai/openhuman for merge conflicts, judge which are still relevant to the codebase, then run pr-fix on the ones worth rescuing.
